description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for updating driver information in the fleet management system. Contains optional fields for driver attributes such as name, email, phone, license number, and status, with validation and schema annotations.

classes.name: DriverUpdateRequest
classes.description: DTO class representing a request payload to update a driver's details. All fields are optional and may be used to modify existing driver information.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the driver from the update request.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the driver from the update request.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the driver from the update request.

methods.name: getPhone
methods.description: Returns the phone number of the driver from the update request.

methods.name: getLicenseNumber
methods.description: Returns the driver's license number from the update request.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the driver from the update request.

methods.description: Sets the last name of the driver in the update request.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the driver in the update request.

methods.name: setPhone
methods.description: Sets the phone number of the driver in the update request.
